text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: On the way back from an outing with King Halo—

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text: Oh...? Trainer, wait a moment.

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text:
"That poster over there...
It's a movie I've been curious about for a while..."

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text:
How careless of me, I had no idea it was already out.
I'll have to go watch it soon.

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text: "...Wait, huh?!Today is the last day it's in theaters!"

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text: Jeez, seriously?! If I'd known that, we would've gone to the movie theater today instead!
choice_data_list: Do you still want to go see it?

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text:
Right now...?! Well, if we leave now,
we'll make it in time for the last screening!

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text:
"Ah, but no, we really can't!
If we watch it now, we'll definitely miss curfew!"

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text: King is first-rate! Breaking curfew is the sort of thing second-raters do!

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text: ...Still, wouldn't letting your last chance to see the movie slip through your fingers make you truly second-rate...?

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text:
Hmm... Hmmmm!
The choice befitting a first-class lady is...!

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text:
Haaah... That was so much fun♪
Coming to watch was definitely the right choice!
choice_data_list: Looks like I'm not gonna make curfew...
Looks like we're not gonna make curfew...

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text:
What are you saying?!
Are you planning to give up?!

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text:
I may have chosen to watch a movie,
but I haven't given up on making curfew, either!

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text:
There is no such word as 'surrender' in King's dictionary!
I will make curfew no matter what!

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text:
Now, Trainer, what should we do?!
I grant you the privilege of figuring out a solution!
choice_data_list: You want me to think of it...!?
I have to come up with it...?!

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text:
You're my Trainer, so of course you must do your utmost!
Come on, put your brain to work!
choice_data_list: Let's sneak back to the dorm without getting caught.

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text: Without getting caught...? Would that even be possible, I wonder...

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text: While you distract the dorm head, I'll quietly sneak inside, right...?

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text: That's not a bad strategy. Pull it off well!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: After confirming that King Halo had hidden herself in the bushes, I called out to the dorm head.

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
Hello, King's Trainer.
Did you need something?

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
The weather...? Well, it is nighttime,
but it certainly is a beautiful night sky.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: (Rustle!)

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
Hm? Did I just hear
something in the bushes?

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text: M-Meow.

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text: What, just a cute little kitty?

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text: ...Fufu, being a Trainer must be tough.

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text: I'll let it slide today since you're accompanied by a guardian, but could you be more careful next time?

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: And so, thanks to the magnanimous dorm head, King Halo avoided falling into second-rate status.

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text:
A legitimate reason...?
Just what kind of reason is that?
choice_data_list: I'm going to think about that now.

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text:
Hey! That just means you don't
have an answer at all, doesn't it?!

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text: Time is ticking away while we stand around! Let's just get to the academy!

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text:
*sigh*... Even if I ran at 200 km/h now,
I still wouldn't make it in time...

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text:
For a first-rate honor student like King to break curfew...
I wonder what the dorm head will say...

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text: Did something happen with me?

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text:
Gyah!?
Fuji-senpai, what are you doing in a place like this!?

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text:
Have you come to arrest me for committing
an act unbecoming of a first-rate lady...?!

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
There was some urgent shopping I had to do
for the dorm's daily supplies. So I just popped out for a bit.

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
More importantly, running into you two is an absolute miracle!
Would you mind helping me out with some shopping?

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text: It looks like I'll have a ton of luggage, so I'd gladly take any help I can get.
choice_data_list: Looks like we found a legitimate reason.
Looks like we found a legitimate reason.

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text: Huh...? A legitimate reason...?

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text:
Ah!? True, running an errand for the dorm leader
would be a valid excuse for being late!!

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text: The reason I was late...?

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text:
N-No! It's nothing at all!
Ohohohoho!

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text:
Now then, shop as much as you like!
I'll gladly carry all your bags for you!

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
That's quite reassuring.
In that case, I won't hesitate to borrow a hand.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
And so, in exchange for carrying a mountain of luggage,
King Halo narrowly avoided breaking curfew.
